helpMeDecide.title: Product Information
helpMeDecide.analogLine: Analog Line - It is used for fax connection, franking machines, door keepers, and lifts. This product does not provide phone. Select option related to voicemail (Yes/No).
helpMeDecide.conferenceRoomPhone: Conference room phone - This product is for meeting rooms.
helpMeDecide.deskPhone: Desk phone - Select options related to voicemail (Yes/No), and expansion module (used for call forwarding).
helpMeDecide.predefinedSku: Predefined SKU - Select this option if you are a Power user, and you are familiar with the specific SKU required by your team (ex: call center). Use the text box to provide the required SKU.
helpMeDecide.teamsDialtone: Teams Dialtone - This product enables you to call external phone numbers from Teams. When available, this will be the default product that is pre-selected. Select options from the available drop-down options.
helpMeDecide.specialRequest: Special Request - Select this option when you need assistance to select a product. Use the text box to provide details about your request.
